network-popout.title: Network popout
network-popout.description: Production rail networking and shared service lifetime with isolated Wi-Fi: credential retry, disposal and confirm-off. No NetworkManager writes.

notification-center.title: Notification center
notification-center.description: Production history tab with an in-memory production store: searchable live/archive records, individual archive removal and legacy records. No D-Bus or persistence writes.

panel-resources.title: Panel resource handle
panel-resources.description: CPU/RAM handle on the production panel rim, with isolated readings and missing-sensor states.

panel-performance.title: Stable panel / Performance
panel-performance.description: Production Performance content inside the fixed responsive panel with isolated samples, missing readings and zero/full handle levels. Other tabs remain navigation-only in this first preparation.

panel-performance-short.title: Stable panel / Short screen
panel-performance-short.description: The same production Performance composition in a short/narrow viewport, with internal overflow and fixed navigation. No live sampling.

action-menu-brightness.title: Action menu / Brightness
action-menu-brightness.description: Production brightness editor and dim/restore with isolated backlight service. No hardware changes.

action-menu-audio.title: Action menu / Audio
action-menu-audio.description: Production launcher with isolated audio: attached output Slider, repeated mute, Colemak-DH NEIO and slash-to-search. No live device changes.

action-menu-wifi.title: Action menu / Wi-Fi
action-menu-wifi.description: Production launcher with synthetic networks and an isolated network service: radio, rescan, connect, disconnect and the password editor attached to its own row. No live network changes.

action-menu-bluetooth.title: Action menu / Bluetooth
action-menu-bluetooth.description: Production launcher with synthetic devices and an isolated Bluetooth service: adapter power, discovery, connect and disconnect with real pending and failed outcomes.

action-menu-toggles.title: Action menu / Toggles
action-menu-toggles.description: Production launcher with isolated main-keyboard, Keep awake and Night light routes. Main keyboard exposes enabled, disabled, unavailable and failed changes without touching hardware.

panel-tabs.title: Panel tab group
panel-tabs.description: Production top panel with its tab contents unloaded: Tab/Shift+Tab and arrows move the host-owned tab, stop at the visible ends, and Down enters the tab content.

rail-popouts.title: Rail Popouts
rail-popouts.description: Desktop rail rollouts with anchored and nested states.

osd-layer.title: OSD Layer
osd-layer.description: Production OSD with isolated preview services: shared frame expansion around stationary content, or its separate fullscreen DataCapsule presentation.

notification-layer.title: Notification Layer
notification-layer.description: Transfer feedback through the production notification store, rollout and stack.
